quarterly_data.signal: Outlook and segment commentary (DART half-year report): the quartz segment including quartz base materials grew FY2025 revenue 4.8% consolidated and 15.4% separate on new investment and higher utilisation at global semiconductor customers driven by AI, while consolidated operating profit fell 39.9% and separate operating profit rose 24.4%; for 2026 the company expects demand to rise further on customers' process-conversion investment and continued strong AI semiconductor demand, citing WSTS (published 2025-06-03) for a world semiconductor market growing more than 25% year on year in 2026. The ceramics segment grew FY2025 revenue 21.6% on strong semiconductor material demand with its operating loss about 70% smaller and expects profit improvement in 2026 from new products, in a semiconductor high-performance ceramics market QY Research sees growing 8.7% a year from USD 10.4 hundred million in 2022 to USD 17.1 hundred million in 2029. The cleaning and coating segment grew FY2025 consolidated revenue 10.1% on higher customer fab utilisation, with operating profit down 4.5% on US market-entry costs while separate revenue rose 11.6% and separate operating profit 18.5%. H1 R&D spend was KRW 4,114,131 thousand, 1.69% of revenue; recent commercialisations are PVD 5.0 (Flawless) coating co-developed with customer 'Company S' and patented in 2024, ECO-PLUS cleaning for AlN heaters (2024) and for electrostatic chucks (2025), and ALD coating (2025).

quarterly_data.signal: Raw materials and vertical integration (DART half-year report): the fused-quartz base-material market is an oligopoly of a few US, German and Japanese suppliers - one of them Momentive Performance Materials Quartz, Inc., which Wonik QnC itself acquired in 2020 - so securing good base material cheaply and steadily is what drives quartz-ware margins. H1 2026 purchases totalled KRW 125,900M: quartz ware in Korea KRW 62,859M (49.9% of purchases), in Taiwan KRW 24,336M (19.3%), US quartz base material KRW 17,935M (14.2%), US quartz ware KRW 8,066M (6.4%), Germany KRW 3,661M (2.9%) and ceramics materials KRW 4,207M (3.3%). The parent alone bought KRW 10,384,509 thousand of base material from Momentive Performance Materials Quartz in H1 2026 against KRW 9,000,197 thousand a year earlier. Input prices per unit moved to DISC KRW 731 thousand (KRW 678 thousand in FY2025), TUBE KRW 491 thousand (KRW 726 thousand), PLATE KRW 2,222 thousand (KRW 2,341 thousand) and ROD KRW 25 thousand (KRW 42 thousand).
